title: sources-uses-escrow
description: RFC 0056 / format 4.8. One entry of uses.escrows. Shape only: the label rule (ESC-02), the legacy-scalar agreement (ESC-03) and the rate-cap replacement tie (ESC-04) are semantic checks.

name.description: Closed, with a label-bearing `other` — the RFC 0052 shape.

label.description: REQUIRED when name is `other`, and refused otherwise (ESC-02).

upfront.description: Funded at close. At least one of upfront or monthly is stated (ESC-01).
